title: Initiative health tokens and automated SLI reprioritizer
creator: Evelyn Park
description:
Design and deliver a lightweight initiative health model ("health tokens": discrete scores) that synthesizes SLIs, error-budget burn,
and rollout exposure into a single tokenized health signal per initiative.
These tokens power an automated reprioritization engine and guardrail triggers
that propose schedule shifts, canary rollbacks, and resource reallocation across
reliability initiatives. The goal is to reduce time-to-detection of SLI regressions,
make cross-team tradeoffs actionable, and remove manual spreadsheet-based coordination.
acceptance_criteria: Health token algorithm defined with weightings for: 3 canonical SLIs, 2 burn-rate windows, and rollout exposure
Prototype UI that surfaces tokens for all active initiatives in Reliability Initiative Hub
Automated reprioritizer produces actionable suggestions (move, throttle, pause, rollback) for >=80% of simulated SLO-violation scenarios
Playbook that maps token thresholds to concrete ops actions and communicated to oncall and PMs
End-to-end test: when synthetic SLI regression triggers token threshold, a suggested rollback appears in the initiative queue and a notification is sent to stakeholders
notes: Motivation: teams currently track error budgets in ad-hoc dashboards; cross-team prioritization is slow under burn events
Trade-offs discussed: conservative automatic actions vs suggestion-only; we will initially ship suggestion-only with throttled automation for a pilot group
Data sources: Console per-route SLI breakdowns, token-level cost/latency telemetry, rollout meta (canary percent, regions)
Privacy: use aggregated telemetry; no raw customer content included in health calculations
comments: 2025-11-10 - Evelyn Park: scoped initial algorithm (SLI weighting 60%, burn-rate 25%, rollout exposure 15%); drafting PRD
2025-12-08 - Marco Rivera: engineering spike scheduled to validate metric availability and latency for real-time tokens
2026-01-21 - Design review: UX shows token as colored pill + trend sparkline; feedback to add drilldown to contributing signals
2026-02-09 - Security: recommended review of notification channels; recommended restricting automated actions to Dedicated customers during pilot
2026-02-26 - Eng: prototype reprioritizer connected to initiative queue; produced false positives in 2/10 long-tail workload sims, adjusted smoothing window
decision_log: 2025-11-17 - Decision: ship suggestion-only for first 3 quarters; enable automation gated by Dedicated tier opt-in
2025-12-15 - Decision: default token smoothing window set to 30m to reduce transient noise
2026-01-12 - Decision: include rollout exposure (canary size and percent of traffic) as independent signal
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot): small set of reliability initiatives + Dedicated customers (2 weeks) - suggestion-only
Phase 1: expand to all reliability initiatives + opt-in automation for reserved capacity (4 weeks)
Phase 2: global rollout with automated throttles and rollback suggestions to oncall (8 weeks)
Monitoring: dashboard for token distributions, false-positive rate, and operator override frequency
